title: Enzymatic fingerprinting of AX and BG
author: Alison Lovegrove
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.babriam6

steps.title: Weigh flour
steps.instruction: Weigh 100 mg of wheat flour into a 2 mL safe‑lock Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add ethanol and boil
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 80 % ethanol, vortex, securely clamp the tube lid, and place in a heat block for 10 min.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 2 min at 12 000 rpm (or 5 min at 10 000 rpm).

steps.title: Wash with 80 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, add 1 mL 80 % ethanol, resuspend the pellet with a micro‑spatula, and vortex.

steps.title: Wash with 95 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, add 1 mL 95 % ethanol, resuspend the pellet with a micro‑spatula, and vortex.

steps.title: Dry residue
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and dry the remaining residue in a SpeedVac for approximately 2 h.

steps.title: Prepare enzyme stock
steps.instruction: Prepare a master enzyme solution for the number of samples; e.g., for 24 samples make 25 mL containing 50 µL xylanase (Xyn11 or Xyn10) and 23.75 µL lichenase, mix well, and aliquot 1 mL to each tube.

steps.title: Resuspend in reaction
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried flour in 1 mL reaction mixture containing 2 µL Xyn11 (or Xyn10) and 0.95 µL lichenase per sample.

steps.title: Incubate digests
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction tubes for 16 h at 40 °C with shaking at 850 rpm in a Thermomixer (or in a tumbling oven).

steps.title: Spin down digest
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the digested samples for 5 min at 12 000 rpm.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 0.6 mL of the clear supernatant to a new Eppendorf tube, avoiding any pellet material.

steps.title: Heat inactivate enzymes
steps.instruction: Clamp the tube and boil the supernatant for 30 min in a heat block to inactivate enzymes.

steps.title: Post‑heat centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the boiled sample for 2 min at 12 000 rpm.

steps.title: Filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Filter the supernatant through a 0.45 µm Millex‑HV syringe filter mounted on a 2 mL Terumo syringe into a fresh Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Dilute for HPAEC
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:20 dilution by mixing 50 µL filtered supernatant with 950 µL internal standard (10 µM melibiose) in a glass vial with a polyethylene snap cap.

steps.title: Mix diluted sample
steps.instruction: Mix the diluted solution by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Run standard sample
steps.instruction: Process and inject a Hereward defatted white flour standard alongside the samples on the HPAEC system (CarboPac PA1 column).
